name: sokudo-monorepo
description: Sokudo: a compile-to-DOM signals UI framework (monorepo).

scripts.build: bun run build:sokudo && bun run build:docs && bun run build:examples
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/sokudo typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.apps.json
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/sokudo/dist apps/docs/dist apps/docs/.sokudo examples/*/dist examples/*/.sokudo
